title: Add retry guidance for source fetch timeouts
summary: The researcher agent treated a transient fetch timeout as a final source failure and moved forward with weak evidence.

evidence_refs.note: The tool call timed out and the agent did not retry.
The writer received the task after the failed fetch was treated as complete.

problem.issue: When source fetching times out, the researcher proceeds without retrying or marking the evidence as incomplete.
problem.root_cause: The workflow context does not tell the researcher how to distinguish transient fetch failures from real source absence.

insight: Teach the researcher to retry transient source fetch failures once, then mark the evidence incomplete if the retry also fails.

proposed_changes.issue: Source fetch timeouts are treated as final failures.
proposed_changes.insight: Retry transient fetch failures once before handoff; if retry fails, mark the source as incomplete in the handoff payload.

proposed_changes.name: researcher retries fetch timeout before handoff

definition.given: fetch tool times out on first call and succeeds on retry
definition.expect: researcher retries once and includes recovered source in handoff

gate_expectations.notes: Generated check must be repeated before autonomous context apply.
